zh: 显示下载状态和常用操作，窗口关闭时也可使用

zh: 登录信息保存在你的钥匙串中。VidFlow 不会接触你的密码。

en: yt-dlp and Deno come from their GitHub releases, ffmpeg from ffmpeg.martin-riedl.de. aria2 is included with VidFlow.
zh: yt-dlp 和 Deno 来自其 GitHub 发布页，ffmpeg 来自 ffmpeg.martin-riedl.de，aria2 随 VidFlow 提供。

en: Downloaded from ffmpeg.martin-riedl.de when you choose to install it; not bundled with VidFlow. Source code: ffmpeg.org.
zh: 仅在你选择安装时从 ffmpeg.martin-riedl.de 下载，不随 VidFlow 分发。源代码见 ffmpeg.org。

en: Included with VidFlow as a separate program, built from unmodified source.
zh: 作为独立程序随 VidFlow 提供，由未经修改的源代码构建。

en: Extracting audio needs ffmpeg. Install it in Settings › Updates.
zh: 提取音频需要 ffmpeg，请先在“设置 › 更新”中安装。

en: YouTube wants to confirm you're not a bot. Sign in on the Accounts page, or switch proxy node.
zh: YouTube 要求验证身份。请在“账号”页面中登录，或更换代理节点。

en: Network error. Reaching YouTube may require a proxy (Settings › Network).
zh: 网络连接失败。访问 YouTube 可能需要在“设置 › 网络”中配置代理。

en: ffmpeg is required for this. Install it in Settings › Updates.
zh: 此操作需要 ffmpeg，请在“设置 › 更新”中安装。

en: yt-dlp is not installed. Install it in Settings › Updates.
zh: 未找到 yt-dlp，请先在“设置 › 更新”中安装。

en: The site returned no downloadable formats. On YouTube this usually means the sign-in cookies are no longer valid — try signing out of YouTube on the Accounts page, or update yt-dlp.
zh: 网站没有返回可下载的格式。在 YouTube 上通常是登录状态（Cookie）已失效所致，可在“账号”页面中退出 YouTube 登录后重试，或更新 yt-dlp。

en: Couldn't get this Douyin video. It may have been deleted or be private, or it may need an account (sign in on the Accounts page).
zh: 无法获取这个抖音作品：可能已删除、仅作者可见，或需要登录（可在“账号”页面中登录抖音后重试）。

en: Couldn't read browser cookies. Quit that browser and retry, or use in-app sign-in instead. Safari needs Full Disk Access.
zh: 读取浏览器 Cookie 失败。请退出该浏览器后重试，或改用应用内登录。读取 Safari 需要“完全磁盘访问权限”。

en: Couldn't read the browser's cookies, so they were skipped. In-app sign-in is more reliable.
zh: 无法读取浏览器 Cookie，本次已跳过。建议改用应用内登录。

en: Without ffmpeg only lower quality downloads and audio can't be extracted. Install it in Settings › Updates.
zh: 未安装 ffmpeg，只能下载低画质且无法提取音频。可在“设置 › 更新”中安装。

en: Some higher-quality YouTube formats need Deno. Install it in Settings › Updates.
zh: YouTube 部分高画质格式需要 Deno，可在“设置 › 更新”中安装。

en: Paste video links or share text
